d:
In this episode of The Lallantop’s series ‘Hum Bihar Ke Log’, meet the Panda community of Gaya, the keepers of ancestral records for generations. Discover the traditions of Shraddh, Pind Daan, and Tarpan, and find out why the Gayapal Pandas are upset over the trend of online Pind Daan.
Watch this insightful report by Vikas Verma, Amitesh, and Shivani Dalakoti.
Production: Vikas Verma, Amitesh Kumar & Dalakoti
Executed By: Amitesh Kumar
